Chests and lock picking

On by default. Chests in towns and castles can be picked open with lockpicks (bought in the stolen goods bag menu of a town). Scenes with too few usable chests get a few extra chests placed next to barrels and crates. Turn the pick with the mouse, left stick or the wheel keys; hold the confirm key to turn the lock, and let go when it jams or the pick snaps. Passersby can see you while you pick and loot; if they catch you, it goes to a confrontation like a failed pickpocket. Loot goes into the stolen goods bag (from this settlement, must be laundered); money goes straight to you. A looted chest refills after a few days.
